review.notes: Every extracted PDF page line was compared against the OCR markdown with normalization and fuzzy matching; code-fence balance, all markdown headings and the five HTML tables (cell counts and values against the PDF text layer) were checked. Rendered physical pages 1 and 2 were visually inspected, the page-2 spelling at 300 dpi. OCR auto-corrected the print's own misspelling 'exhibites' to 'exhibits', and the printed two-column Figure 1 sub-captions were transcribed as interleaved fragments. Figure-internal chart labels (pages 1, 3, 5, 6) are inside embedded figures and were not transcribed as body text.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.2 (300 dpi crop) prints 'due to the limited amount of training data and the relatively small model capacity, it exhibites certain shortcomings'; the print itself misspells 'exhibites' and OCR silently corrected it to 'exhibits'. The print's spelling is restored.
